description: Sonnet rubric over hypotheses generated from a sustainability brief (R-1 / D-046)
brief_content: We are scoping a study on how urban Indian consumers evaluate sustainability claims on packaged-goods labels. Objective: identify the heuristics consumers use to decide which claims are credible, the signals that shift trust positively or negatively, and the differences in scepticism across categories (food, personal care, home cleaning). Audience: brand and packaging teams at FMCG companies, plus regulators interested in labelling reform.
